messages:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hit a parity snag. REST /v1/embeddings accepts query `include_user_flags=true` and returns a 3-tuple shape, but Node SDK v0.12.3 ignores that flag and we get the old 2-tuple response. User-facing quickstart broken :exclamation:

sam: Ugh. Which sampleapp branch? can you paste the SDK call you used?

maya: main branch quickstart. Repro steps: use the Node quickstart, call `client.embeddings.create(model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'hello', include_user_flags: true)` and SDK silently drops `include_user_flags` (no error). REST curl with `?include_user_flags=true` returns extra metadata.

sam: thanks. Quick guess — SDK parameter shape changed a while back (params moved under options object). Can you try `client.embeddings.create({model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'hello'}, {include_user_flags: true})`?

maya: tried that — still no. I added a wiretrace and SDK sends body `{model, input}` only, no query. REST expects that as a query flag. So we have both a missing-feature parity issue and a param-shape mismatch in quickstart.

alex: Also flagging that SDK retry behavior diverges. REST/edge returns 4xx immediately for that endpoint, but SDK has default retry-on-5xx logic that retries and masks the original header-based error in traces. Two separate DX problems: (1) missing query param support, (2) retry semantics altering observable failures.

sam: good catch on retries. For (1) we can add `include_user_flags` to the public kwargs mapping and ensure it becomes `?include_user_flags=1`. For (2) we should respect service `x-idempotency-required` header and avoid automatic retries when that header is set. I'll open a tiny patch.

maya: can you also update the quickstart to use the canonical call shape? folks hitting onboarding see different outputs between REST examples in docs and the sampleapp. It's a huge noise source for first-time users.

sam: yup. Plan: 1) augment SDK param mapping, 2) add unit test that asserts query serialization, 3) tweak retry defaults to prefer pass-through errors when endpoint explicitly signals non-idempotent. I'll post a PR in a bit.

deploy-bot: CI: build passed for `fix/sdk-embed-flag` branch — canary deploy queued.

alex: one more thought — we should add an E2E that compares SDK vs REST sample outputs for the quickstarts (sanity check on shape and flags). could catch regressions earlier.

maya: absolutely. If you want I can carve out a tiny post-merge checklist to update docs and the sampleapp snippet. Saves confusion for next cohort. :thumbsup:

sam: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987 — includes mapping + test + notes. If someone from docs can glance at wording, will merge after a quick review.

maya: nice, will update quickstart snippet after merge. thanks all.
